request: Should we move our CI from the self-hosted Jenkins server to GitHub Actions, and switch our test runner from nose to pytest?
facts: One engineer spends about four hours a week keeping the Jenkins server running. The GitHub Actions minutes our builds would use fit in the plan we already pay for.
nose has had no release since 2015 and fails on Python 3.12, which the team moves to next quarter. In a trial, pytest ran the existing tests unchanged.
The two changes do not depend on each other, and each can be undone on its own.
The team asked for both changes in the last retrospective.
note: Two actions that can be decided separately in one request: the framing should make one the main proposal and the other a follow-up. Checks that limiting follow-ups to actions in the request (1.6.2) does not also remove legitimate ones. A made-up situation.
